title: zannichellia palustris subsp. aculeata
intro: Zannichellia palustris subsp. aculeata, commonly known as Stalked Hornwort, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Zannichelliaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, gout, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Stalked Hornwort are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Stalked Hornwort, such as flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, have been identified as key contributors to its medicinal properties, providing a potential source for the development of new therapeutic agents.
